correctness.rationale: The joint EGF expression J_i(n)=p_i(n−1)![z^(n−1)]∏_{h≠i}(e^(p_h z)−1) is exact for iid positive categorical sampling. For p_i<p_j, strip the remaining m−2 factors to c_t. Each q^u/u!, u>=1, is log concave, and TP2 Toeplitz convolution preserves log concavity; a_u/b_u=(p_j/p_i)^u rises strictly. Pairwise determinant A_(k+1)B_k−A_kB_(k+1) decomposes into nonnegative cross terms, and the term u=k−(m−2)+1,v=1 has strict c_(m−2)c_(k−1)>0 for m>=3. m=2 ratio geometric; equal masses symmetric; J_i(m) independent of i. Thus all n>=m odds strictly increase, and normalized conditional law gives likelihood ratio and usual stochastic ordering. Independent rational subset-DP vs coefficient test confirmed five vectors incl equality cases through m+8; unrestricted theorem is analytical.
residual_risks: Requires iid time-homogeneous positive probabilities, only first appearance stopping.
